entries.zh: 吼叫；犬吠而咬人。西语并列「吠、咬」二义，皆就犬之吼吠言之。
entries.en: to roar, to bark; to bite (of a dog barking and snapping).
entries.notes: M 栏并存两读「Hài. goir,」且末尾逗号示未毕，第二读义不明；本义依 吼=háu（吠吼）定。

entries.zh: 威嚴、嚴厲：神色或威勢之峻厲逼人。
entries.en: severe, harsh; awe-inspiring in mien or authority.
entries.notes: M 栏仅存缩写「ng.」，与『威』常读 ui 不合，释义依 H 栏『威』定。

entries.zh: 漠然、神情凝重而不理人。
entries.en: grave and indifferent; paying no heed to others.
entries.notes: H 栏 穆/漠 存疑，M「bō」近『無』，取『漠然不應』一义。

entries.zh: 儀容威重、令人敬憚之人。
entries.en: a man of grave, awe-inspiring bearing; one looked on with respect.
entries.notes: H 栏第三字 形/儀 存疑；『威形』非常语，义近『威儀』。

entries.zh: 威儀：威重自持，人不敢輕慢直呼。
entries.en: awe-inspiring dignity; of such presence that none dares address him familiarly.
entries.notes: L 栏「deslome dirsele」系原稿讹写（当作 dezirle），义取『无人敢直呼之』。

entries.zh: 宏大：氣象不凡而自持不屈。
entries.en: grand and lofty; unbending, not humbling itself.
entries.notes: L 后半「no se humilla」与 H『宏大』不完全对齐，取『气象宏大而不肯屈己』合之。

entries.zh: 非常、重大：要緊而非尋常之事。
嚴肅、不苟言笑；儀態端嚴。
entries.notes: L「seuio」疑为 serio/severo 之讹；H 栏末字 態/熊 存疑，M 与『範態』相合。

entries.zh: 待人接物莊重自持，有架子。
entries.en: grave and aloof in dealing with others; standing on his dignity.
on a grand scale; of imposing magnitude.

entries.zh: 急切要緊：令人掛心、操勞到底之事。
entries.en: pressing, urgent; a matter that engrosses one and pains him to the end.

entries.zh: （字書凡例）某字作字頭時表「莊重」之義；所舉漢字與注音對應不明。
entries.en: editorial note: as an initial character it denotes gravity; the character–transcription correspondence is unclear.
entries.notes: L 为凡例式说明而非词义，H『盒』与 M「cuà. cāy.」均无法与『庄重』义相配，故存疑。
M「chūy」与『莊』常读不合，或系另一读或讹写，释义依 H 栏。

entries.zh: 儀容端莊凝重，兼指面色之美。
entries.en: stately and grave of countenance; dignified beauty of face.
entries.notes: M 栏「giàm chūng giam. chūng giam」为重复誊写，次二字所指不明。
